description:
Viewer component of the main DicomObjects.Net DICOM library.  A .NET MAUI backed library for CPU and GPU accelerated rendering with SkiaSharp to provide 2D and 3D viewing.
      The API is user-friendly and is aimed to provide easy ways to build DICOM solution. This library is actively supported by MedicalConnections Ltd, UK. If you have any questions please contact our support team.
releaseNotes:
DicomImage.Bitmap Prevent reassigning exceptions by rethrowing so original exception can be viewed.
EOT tags are removed when transcoding on a Write, if same-syntax Write then EOT tags are kept and an Empty BOT is created.
SKOpenGL incorrect matrix multiplication ordering causing pixel shifts fix.
When pixel data > 4294967296 bytes the BOT is made empty (for all BasicOffsetTableHandling options).
if SeekableBotHandling Seek option is selected and data is > 4294967296 then BOT is made empty and pixel data is shifted to remove that pre-allocated BOT length space.
Added a new WriteBehaviour option, SequentialFrameProcessing, which processes frames sequentially rather than in parallel during encoding, reducing memory consumption at the expense of encoding speed.
BOT mode selection fix between WriteBehaviour.SeekableBotHandling and WriteBehaviour.NonSeekableBotHandling when the stream is seek able (was only considering FileStreams).
Avoid double scale-down with Zoom and resLevel (J2K output size is down double what's requested).
JpegXL support added into DicomObjects (libjxl).
Padding byte when odd fragment stream length.
Optimised JPEG encoding to write only the quantization tables required by the image, omitting unused chrominance quantization tables for monochrome images (Jpeg XL Recompression will throw exception if there are unused quantization tables).
Omit BOT if Video TS, each fragment is added to a single frame.
Public API change - FixPossibleExplictTagsWithinImplicitSequence renamed to FixPossibleExplicitTagsWithinImplicitSequence (spelling mistake)
Only throw OpenGL is unavailable exception when its actually unavailable and not just when a render fails.
Added DicomGlobal.IsOpenGLAvailable() to check whether OpenGL can be initialized on the machine.
DicomDataSet.GetMinAndMax fix overwriting reslevel with Full.
DicomImage.Bitmap fix to prevent creating a subset of the bitmap that was outside the image dimensions.
Added DicomDataSet.GetNativeFrame method for "stored" pixel data.
J2K codec, check if SIZ marker is defined correctly.
Resolution level is considered when windowing tags are missing and windowing values are calculated from the pixel data, the pixels histogram account for the resolution level when retrieving from cache.
